fact: The Public Procurement Authority says 3205 tenders had been published on GHANEPS by 23 April 2024.
The Public Procurement Authority says 5048 contracts had been awarded in GHANEPS from 3205 published tenders as of 23 April 2024, 64 per cent of the tenders being requests for quotations.
The Public Procurement Authority says GHANEPS, launched 30 April 2019, had been rolled out to 869 public entities in all 16 regions by September 2023.
The Public Procurement Authority says the grace period has ended and it is now mandatory for all public entities to use GHANEPS for their procurement activities.
The Public Procurement Authority's chief executive says tenders are submitted online through GHANEPS, with manual tender submissions to be phased out.
The Public Procurement Authority board chairman says utilisation of GHANEPS is about 45%.
